models.name: 1675 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: Former frontage partially obscured by the adjacent event tent. The tent is temporary.
Operator photo shows the dark retained storefront and thin flat canopy.

models.roof_fit_notes: The long ridge is asymmetrical and the shallow dark entrance canopy is outside the principal roof. The rear façade and entry dimensions are approximate.

models.name: 1809 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: The forecourt shows the green sloped fascia, yellow strip awnings, inset door and street-facing glazing.
Track Town Pizza gives the registered address.

models.roof_fit_notes: The pale west strip has a lower continuous roof. The entry recess and green upper fascia are simplified from the forecourt panorama.

models.name: 1895 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: Short-end transparent frontage, brown parapet band, and drive-through circulation to its east in the view.
The broker gallery supplies the site boundary, ground-level facade and roof equipment.

models.roof_fit_notes: The roof includes a raised side projection and visible plant. Glazing and drive-through openings are mapped approximately. The materials represent the 2024 Starbucks exterior.

models.name: 1917 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: The shop frontage shows daylight glazing and service bays behind the elevated row of solar panels.

models.roof_fit_notes: The south roof strip is a tilted photovoltaic row above the building. The foliage obscures the ends of the service frontage. Bay widths and the last bay are approximate.

models.name: 1933 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: Broad low gray hips over a recessed south gallery with yellow piers. 2001 Franklin is an adjacent building.

models.roof_fit_notes: A rectangular recessed roof area interrupts the upper hips, with smaller plant on the recessed deck. Foliage and the roof edge obscure the rear elevation.

models.name: 2091 Franklin Blvd

public_references.observation: Street View shows a free passage on both sides of the fuel canopy supports and the glazed shop behind.
State list places BUY2 023 at the address during the aerial acquisition.

models.roof_fit_notes: The source outline includes the open fuel cover. Only the enclosed shop and two approximate canopy supports participate in collision. Pump equipment, trade dress and interior are outside this review.
